# gramlot-py-server 0.3.30 — asset revalidation and core page policy

- `gramlot.js` and the themes are revalidated with `ETag` and `Last-Modified`; a matching conditional request gets 304 instead of the full file.
- The page policy is composed by the core: with libraries from jsDelivr it carries the CDN origin.
- New adapter option `library_source` (`cdn` default, `local`), passed to `GramlotServer`.
- Requires gramlot 0.3.34 (third-party libraries loaded on first use).
- Gallery tests and the chart reports and system monitor demos follow the paths of gramlot-examples 0.3.41.

Qualification: full test suite green on GitHub Actions (published core, every host adapter, browser checks).
